environmental_sound_classification.benchmark: ESC-50, all 2000 clips, official five folds
environmental_sound_classification.evaluation: Each model sees only its advertised held-out fold; accuracy and macro-F1.
environmental_sound_classification.preprocessing: Author training implementation: (fbank - mean) / (2 * std). HF convenience-preprocess result retained separately.
environmental_sound_classification.scope: Published-checkpoint inference reproduction, no retraining. Not an independent audit of upstream model selection.

audio_reasoning.benchmark: All environmental-sound questions in the official MMAU-test-mini snapshot
audio_reasoning.evaluation: Strict parsed choice accuracy with all questions in denominator; audio-hash cluster bootstrap and paired cluster sign-flip test account for repeated recordings. Question-level Wilson and McNemar statistics are exploratory.
audio_reasoning.controls: 60 silent and 60 mismatched inputs with fixed questions, reported separately as original-answer retention.
audio_reasoning.scope: Sound partition, not full MMAU speech/music score. Prompt and decoding differ from some upstream reported results.

machine_audio_qa.benchmark: All 200 held-out DCASE2020 pilot clips; 100 normal, 100 anomalous across fan/pump.
machine_audio_qa.controls: 40 silent and 40 quarter-second excerpts; expected abstention is a protocol rule.
machine_audio_qa.evaluation: Accuracy, normal specificity, anomaly sensitivity, abstention, parse failures.
machine_audio_qa.scope: A diagnostic generalization test, not physical fault diagnosis or an official QA benchmark.

noise_aware_machine_asd.benchmark: DCASE2026 development, seven machine types, all 1000 normal train + 200 test clips per type
noise_aware_machine_asd.input: 16 kHz synchronous near and far microphones; NA uses far as auxiliary reference, BEATs uses near only.
noise_aware_machine_asd.backend: Normal-only cosine 1NN, global/frequency average pooling, frequency-wise BEAM-style banks, RDP gamma=4.
noise_aware_machine_asd.precision: CUDA BF16 autocast, float32 pooling and cosine scores; at most 16 exact-length clips per batch.
noise_aware_machine_asd.evaluation: Source AUC, target AUC, standardized pAUC FPR<=0.1; harmonic mean across all machine/metric components.
noise_aware_machine_asd.scope: Frozen seed0 frontend and paper-described backend ideas. Excludes discriminative fine-tuning, score rescaling and three-seed ensemble; not a reproduction of the full 70.24 competition result.

selection_policy: Protocols are chosen from official code/docs; no prompt, threshold, pooling exponent or checkpoint is selected using resulting test metrics. All specified ASD variants are reported.
